plainTranslation: Their intensity and pull toward depth and control press against how freely you present yourself and enter situations.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their intensity and pull toward depth and control press against how freely you present yourself and enter situations. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
